description: Visual indicator of an operation in progress.

howToUse: Use it for a short wait with no known end, in a small place: a button, a field, a card loading.
Give it an `aria-label` that says what is happening ("Loading invoices").
alternatives: Content with a known shape loading: Skeleton.

keyboard.action: The spinner does not receive focus.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Defines a string value that labels the current element.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Callback called when the value changes.
